{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Exclude rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
valid_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
deduplicated = valid_baseline.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline
mean_baseline = deduplicated['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline != -999: {len(valid_baseline)}")
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated)}")
print(f"Number of patients with biomarker_baseline = -999: {len(df) - len(valid_baseline)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value: {mean_baseline}")"}
